Q. 1 قَرْنَصَ البَازِىَ He acquired for himself, permanently, for the chase, the hawk, or falcon, (S, K, TA,) by tying it up in order that its feathers might drop off. (TA.) ＝
-A2- قَرْنَصَ البَازِى The hawk, or falcon, became a permanent acquisition for the chase: the verb being intrans. as well as trans. (K.) Lth mentions it as being written with س [i. e. قَرْنَسَ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
